integrity: Proof supplied; an independent mathematical audit has not been performed. Kawasaki's original full text was unavailable, but the precise relevant cohomology result was checked in Bahri–Franz–Ray.
scientific_limitations: Universal cover and the first three homotopy groups are identified, not the full quotient homotopy type; ordinary homology groups are special cases of Kawasaki's general weighted-lens calculations; p=3 finite model does not prove the infinite theorem.
title: A doubly suspended lens universal cover for singular type-\(B_{2p}\) Coxeter quotients
